info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Disbursement Management API
info.description: This API facilitates the management of disbursements associated with loans. It allows users to modify the details of a specific disbursement by referencing the unique identifiers of both the loan and the disbursement. Typical consumers of this API include loan servicing systems and financial institutions that need to adjust disbursement data in response to changes or corrections. By providing an efficient means to update disbursement information, the API supports improved accuracy and customer service in financial transactions.

patch.summary: Update disbursement details for a specific loan
patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific disbursement associated with a loan. You can modify various attributes related to the disbursement, providing a flexible way to manage loan funds.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the disbursement details for a specific loan. It contains all the necessary data to modify the existing disbursement identified by RES-100045. Ensure that the JSON format conforms to the specified schema.
